result.summary: The intersection features a marked crosswalk and traffic signals, but pedestrian safety is compromised by a lack of continuous sidewalks on both sides of the street. Large bushes on the corner create a significant visual obstruction, and the wide roadway design likely encourages higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large, dense bushes on the northwest corner block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the roadway lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on unpaved surfaces or in the street shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove the large bushes at the corner to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians at the intersection.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, characterized by the complete absence of a continuous sidewalk along a multi-lane roadway. Pedestrians are forced to navigate unpaved grass or the roadway itself, with no dedicated infrastructure for walking or crossing.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no continuous paved walkway, forcing pedestrians onto uneven grass or into the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire roadside edge in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Unprotected Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked crossings or pedestrian refuge, creating a high-risk environment for anyone attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire visible span of the asphalt roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might be entering the roadway from the grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Cars parked along the right side of the frame.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved, ADA-compliant sidewalk along the entire block to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: This is a wide, multi-lane urban thoroughfare with four travel lanes and parallel parking on both sides. While continuous sidewalks are provided, the environment is dominated by vehicle traffic with no visible pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway width, spanning four travel lanes and two parking lanes, requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without any refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible for a long stretch of this high-capacity road, increasing the risk of mid-block crossing conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway length

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians, particularly shorter individuals, from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbsides

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, significantly reducing exposure risk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the travel lanes.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement marked crossings with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage to clearly define right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk. However, the wide roadway and faded pavement markings suggest a design that prioritizes vehicle movement, potentially leading to higher speeds in a residential context.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the curb

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, open nature of the intersection without traffic calming may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking at the corner.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
